summary: This bill directs the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to publish quarterly reports on arrests, detentions, and deportations, including the criminal conviction status and threat level designation of the individuals involved.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on directing ICE to report on arrests, detentions, and deportations, categorizing individuals by criminal offense and 'threat level.' This directly relates to the enforcement aspect of immigration, aiming to provide transparency on ICE's activities, which aligns with securing borders.
